title: A Benefit Without a Name
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空事例。実在の人物、組織、法律、調査結果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: An organization that wishes to recognize valuable contributions may create a public record of the people whose efforts have supported a common activity.
sentences.ja: 価値ある貢献を認めたい組織は共通活動を支えた人の努力の公開記録を作るかもしれない。

sentences.en: Such recognition can communicate appreciation and help participants understand that an achievement involved the work of several people rather than the actions of a single individual.
sentences.ja: その評価は感謝を伝え、一つの成果が単独個人の行動でなく複数人の働きを伴ったことを参加者が理解する助けになり得る。

sentences.en: However, publicly identifying a person's contribution may not always correspond to the way that person wishes to be recognized.
sentences.ja: しかし貢献者の公の特定は常に本人が評価されたい方法と一致するとは限らない。

sentences.en: The ethical question concerns not only whether an action deserves acknowledgment but also what form that acknowledgment should take.
sentences.ja: 倫理的な問いは行動が承認に値するかだけでなくその承認がどんな形を取るべきかにも関わる。

sentences.en: Imagine a fictional community project in which volunteers prepare educational materials for a group of children.
sentences.ja: ボランティアが子供集団のため教育教材を準備する架空地域活動を想像しよう。

sentences.en: The organizers plan to publish a report containing a list of participants who made significant contributions during the preparation of the materials.
sentences.ja: 主催者は教材準備中に重要な貢献をした参加者の一覧を含む報告を公開する計画を立てる。

sentences.en: One volunteer explains that she is pleased to have supported the project but prefers not to have her name included in the public report.
sentences.ja: 一人は活動を支援できてうれしいが公開報告に名前を含めることを望まないと説明する。

sentences.en: Another volunteer asks whether excluding the names of particular contributors could produce a misleading impression of the way the project was completed.
sentences.ja: 別のボランティアは一部貢献者の名前を除外すると活動の実施方法について誤解を招く印象が生じるか尋ねる。

sentences.en: The organizers distinguish two purposes that the proposed report was intended to serve.
sentences.ja: 主催者は報告案が果たすことを意図された二つの目的を区別する。

sentences.en: One is to communicate appreciation to the people who provided assistance, while the other is to present an accurate account of the resources and activities involved in the project.
sentences.ja: 一つは援助した人への感謝を伝えること、他方は活動に伴う資源と作業の正確な説明を提示することだ。

sentences.en: These purposes may be achieved through different forms of communication without requiring every participant to appear in an identical public list.
sentences.ja: これらの目的は全参加者が同一の公開名簿に載ることを求めず異なる意思疎通形式で達成され得る。

sentences.en: The report might describe the various kinds of work performed by volunteers and indicate that some people chose not to be publicly identified.
sentences.ja: 報告はボランティアの実行した多様な仕事を記述し、一部の人が名前の公開特定を望まなかったことを示せるかもしれない。

sentences.en: The organizers could also communicate appreciation privately, provided that doing so was consistent with the wishes of the people concerned.
sentences.ja: 関係者の希望と一致するなら感謝を私的に伝えることもできる。

sentences.en: A further consideration involves the accuracy of a report that attributes particular results to particular individuals.
sentences.ja: さらに特定個人に特定結果を帰する報告の正確性も考慮する必要がある。

sentences.en: Some contributions may be difficult to describe separately because they were valuable primarily in combination with activities performed by other people.
sentences.ja: 他者が行った活動と組み合わさって主に価値があったため、一部貢献は個別記述が難しいかもしれない。

sentences.en: The attempt to acknowledge individual achievement can consequently produce an account that gives insufficient attention to the relationships among different contributions.
sentences.ja: 個人の成果を認める試みはそこで異なる貢献間の関係へ十分注意しない説明を生む場合がある。

sentences.en: The fictional project does not establish legal requirements for publishing personal information or prove that a particular method of recognition improves cooperation.
sentences.ja: 架空活動は個人情報公開の法的要件を確立せず特定評価法が協力を改善することも証明しない。

sentences.en: It illustrates how a decision about acknowledgment may affect both the interests of contributors and the accuracy of the account that a community presents about its work.
sentences.ja: 承認についての判断が貢献者の利益と地域が提示する作業説明の正確性の双方にどう影響し得るか例示する。

sentences.en: An expression of gratitude can be meaningful without making every recipient publicly identifiable.
sentences.ja: 感謝の表明は全受け手を公に特定可能にせずとも意味あるものになり得る。

sentences.en: Similarly, an accurate description of a collective achievement need not always take the form of a complete list of individual names.
sentences.ja: 同様に集団成果の正確な説明は常に個人名の完全一覧の形式を取る必要はない。

sentences.en: Responsible recognition involves considering the relationship between a person's contribution, the person's expectations, and the purpose of the information being communicated.
sentences.ja: 責任ある承認には貢献、本人の期待、伝えられる情報の目的の関係を考慮することが伴う。

sentences.en: A benefit without a name remains a benefit, even when the people who received it cannot publicly identify the person responsible for providing it.
sentences.ja: 名前のない善意も、それを受けた人が提供者を公に特定できなくても善意のままである。

questions.prompt: What ethical tension does the passage introduce?
options: Recognition can be valuable without necessarily matching a person's preferred form of acknowledgment.
Every public report necessarily misrepresents its contributors.
An achievement can never involve several people.
Gratitude is valuable only when it is expressed publicly.
questions.explanation_ja: 承認の価値と本人の希望。

questions.prompt: What can a record of contributions communicate?
options: The exact private wishes of everyone.
Proof of every individual's superiority.
Appreciation and the collective nature of an achievement.
A universal obligation to publish names.
That every volunteer's name be deleted.
That the educational materials be destroyed.
That the organization cancel the report entirely.
That her name not appear in the public report.
questions.explanation_ja: 自身の名前を公開しないこと。

questions.prompt: What concern does another volunteer raise?
options: The project can never be completed without publication.
Omitting some names might misrepresent the project's contributions.
Private gratitude always costs too much.
Everyone must be identified to receive assistance.
questions.explanation_ja: 貢献の全体像が不正確になる可能性。

options: Expressing appreciation and accurately describing the work involved.
Recruiting more volunteers and selling all the materials.
Making the project longer and reducing its resources.
Comparing the names and ages of participants.

questions.prompt: How might the report serve its second purpose without naming everyone?
options: List only the organizer as responsible for every result.
Remove all descriptions of volunteer activity.
Describe the kinds of work and note that some contributors chose not to be identified.
Invent names for unnamed volunteers.
questions.explanation_ja: 作業の種類と匿名希望の明示。

questions.prompt: Why can individual attribution be difficult?
options: Every contributor necessarily performs identical tasks.
The value of some work depends on its combination with other contributions.
The organization has no records of any activity.
Only individually named work can be useful.

questions.prompt: What does the fictional example not prove?
options: The possibility of different preferences about recognition.
The importance of an accurate description of work.
The relevance of the purpose of a report.
That one recognition method improves cooperation in actual projects.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の協力改善は未実証。

options: Required to participate in every activity.
Completely unrelated to an achievement.
Able to be recognized as a particular person.
Expressed in a private conversation.

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the argument?
options: Responsible acknowledgment respects contributors' preferences while communicating the collective work accurately.
All contributions must be publicly linked to individual names.
Unnamed contributions have no value to the community.
Private appreciation always prevents an accurate report.
questions.explanation_ja: 本人の希望と正確な共同成果の説明。
